title: Number Merge 2048
description: Slide the tiles, merge matching numbers, and reach 2048 in this original mobile-friendly puzzle game.
instructions: Use arrow keys or WASD to move. Swipe or tap the arrows on mobile. Merge matching tiles to reach 2048.

title: Sudoku
description: Solve the classic 9×9 number puzzle with a timer and completion effects.
instructions: Select an empty cell, then choose a number from 1 to 9. Use Clear Cell or Backspace to erase.

title: Line Trap
description: Draw temporary barriers to stop incoming enemies before they reach the core.
instructions: Press Start, then drag on the playfield to draw barriers. Protect the blue core until all enemies are gone.

title: Ludo
description: Play the classic race-to-home board game in your browser.
instructions: Follow the on-screen dice and token controls to take turns and move your pieces.
